thread:
maya: heads up — AcmeEdge's signed PO is stuck in the marketplace portal. portal returns a 422: 'unsupported_esign_provider'. they used a local e-sign (GovSign) that meets their country regs but the marketplace only accepts DocuSign.
raj: ugh. is it failing at upload or at the payer/merchant validation step?
maya: upload — the UI rejects the file with that error. procurement at acme says they can't switch to DocuSign due to eIDAS token requirements for their board signatory.
amanda: legal flagged that our standard PO SOW had an indemnity redline anyway. if we accept a different esign provider we need a one-off acceptance and an attestation from their sig authority.
jess: marketplace API is strict — param esign.provider must be set to 'docusign' in the PO metadata. we can't change that on our side (marketplace vendor rules).
maya: two asks: 1) can legal sign off on one-off acceptance of GovSign with attestation? 2) can finance accept a manual PO/email workflow in our accounting system while we sort marketplace ack?
legal-bot: automated note — escalate to Legal Escalations queue with attachments: partner_esign_attestation.pdf + redline_summary.docx. Required: recorded chain-of-custody + identity verification. See https://redwood/legal/esign-guidance
amanda: happy to draft attestation language. question for finance: what's the minimum metadata you need to create the invoice/ledger so we don't block the partner's delivery?
finance-bot: invoice import accepts CSV with headers: invoice_number, po_number, vendor_tax_id, gross_amount, currency, invoice_date. Attachments accepted as PDF. Example snippet:
```
invoice_number,po_number,vendor_tax_id,gross_amount,currency,invoice_date
INV-2026-123,PO-88997,GB123456789,12500,EUR,2026-06-01
```
We also need vendor legal name to match bank details. If legal approves esign exception, finance can process as 'manual acceptance' and mark as pending marketplace reconciliation.
raj: operational note — if we go manual, we should still file a ticket with marketplace to whitelist GovSign for this partner's vendor_id. that'll prevent future manual flows.
maya: ok plan: amanda will prepare attestation and redline summary by EOD tomorrow; legal to confirm exception + required proof; finance to accept manual invoice with the CSV fields above; raj to open vendor-whitelist ticket with marketplace. tagging @amanda @raj @jess
jess: i'll also add a short-term docs note in the partner onboarding doc: "If marketplace rejects esign, contact partnerships" :memo:
maya: thanks team — want this closed before the partner's delivery window (Fri). i'll ping if anything stalls. :pray:
